caption: The trial caps you at 50 records, and the import screen says so before you start: Your plan allows 50 records and you already have 2 records. The banner shows 10 days left. Our name is hidden.
Our two test contacts arrived with their accented names, example emails and the extra test_id and free_text columns we added as new fields. Our name is hidden.
Getting the contacts back out looked fine at first: the export job shows Completed with a Download button. Our name is hidden.
Clicking Download gave a 404 Page Not Found page, so we never got our contacts back out of the trial.
